_comment: Template for a KDB schema mapping entry. Copy this file to format-database/<format_id>.json and fill in every field. Remove this _comment key in the real entry. The field_map must contain an entry for every mandatory SAGE field listed here. A KDB entry that omits a mandatory field is considered incomplete.
references: <paper citation, e.g. Author et al. (YYYY), DOI>

field_map._comment: One entry per mandatory SAGE LHaloTree field (see reference/sage_lhalotree_hdf5_schema.md for HDF5, reference/sage_lhalotree_binary_schema.md for binary). Field key names here are the writer-facing names used by both hdf5_writer and binary_writer — they must match exactly. Pointer fields are reconstructed via pointer_logic, not copied directly — set conversion_expr to 'see pointer_logic' for those.

Descendant.target_units: integer index within Tree<X> halo array
Descendant.notes: Temporal pointer. Reconstructed from the input's descendant identifier. See pointer_logic.Descendant for format-specific logic.

FirstProgenitor.target_units: integer index within Tree<X> halo array
FirstProgenitor.notes: Temporal pointer. The most massive progenitor. See pointer_logic.FirstProgenitor.

NextProgenitor.target_units: integer index within Tree<X> halo array
NextProgenitor.notes: Temporal pointer. Next in the sibling progenitor chain. See pointer_logic.NextProgenitor.

FirstHaloInFOFGroup.target_units: integer index within Tree<X> halo array
FirstHaloInFOFGroup.notes: Spatial pointer. Central halo of the FOF group. Self-pointer for centrals. See pointer_logic.FirstHaloInFOFGroup.

NextHaloInFOFGroup.target_units: integer index within Tree<X> halo array
NextHaloInFOFGroup.notes: Spatial pointer. Next satellite in the FOF group chain. See pointer_logic.NextHaloInFOFGroup.

SubhaloLen.notes: Number of bound particles. Direct copy if units match.

Group_M_Crit200.notes: Halo mass within R_200_crit. Verify that the source uses critical (not mean) overdensity.

Group_M_Mean200.source_field: <source column/dataset name, or null if unavailable>
Group_M_Mean200.notes: Optional; SAGE reads but does not use for baryonic physics. Use sentinel 0.0 if unavailable.

Group_M_TopHat200.source_field: <source column/dataset name, or null if unavailable>
Group_M_TopHat200.notes: Optional; SAGE reads but does not use for baryonic physics. Use sentinel 0.0 if unavailable.

SubhaloPos.source_field: <source column/dataset name for [X, Y, Z] position>
SubhaloPos.scale_factor: <e.g. 1 if source is already in kpc/h; 1000 if source is in Mpc/h>
SubhaloPos.conversion_expr: <e.g. source_field * 1000 if source is in Mpc/h>
SubhaloPos.notes: 3-vector [X, Y, Z]. Output shape: (N, 3). Ensure comoving coordinates. On-disk values must be in kpc/h for both output formats: the HDF5 reader multiplies by 0.001 post-read; binary_writer divides by 1000 before packing.

SubhaloVel.notes: Peculiar velocity 3-vector [Vx, Vy, Vz]. Output shape: (N, 3).

SubhaloVelDisp.source_field: <source column/dataset name, or null if unavailable>
SubhaloVelDisp.notes: Optional; SAGE reads but does not use for baryonic physics. Use sentinel 0.0 if unavailable.

SubhaloVMax.notes: Maximum circular velocity max(sqrt(GM(<r>)/r)). Not the velocity modulus. Verify against source definition.

SubhaloSpin.scale_factor: <e.g. 1 if source is already in (kpc/h)(km/s); 1000 if source is in (Mpc/h)(km/s)>
SubhaloSpin.notes: Specific angular momentum 3-vector [Jx, Jy, Jz] — angular momentum per unit mass, NOT the dimensionless spin parameter lambda. On-disk values must be in (kpc/h)(km/s) for both output formats: the HDF5 reader multiplies by 0.001 post-read; binary_writer divides by 1000 before packing. Output shape: (N, 3).

SubhaloIDMostBound.source_field: <source column/dataset name for most-bound particle ID, or null>
SubhaloIDMostBound.notes: int64. Use sentinel -1 if unavailable in the input format.

SnapNum.notes: Zero-based. Verify that the input uses the same indexing convention.

FileNr.source_field: <source column/dataset name, or null if unavailable>
FileNr.notes: Optional; SAGE reads but does not use for baryonic physics. Use sentinel -1 if unavailable.

pointer_logic.description: <Describe how the input format encodes temporal and spatial links. E.g. does it store global halo IDs, snapshot-local indices, or pre-built LHaloTree-style pointers? Describe any sorting or re-indexing required to convert to flat per-tree integer indices.>
pointer_logic.FirstProgenitor: <Describe which input field or algorithm yields the main progenitor index. E.g. 'group by descendant ID, sort progenitors by Mvir descending, take first'.>
pointer_logic.NextProgenitor: <Describe how the sibling progenitor chain is built. E.g. 'remaining progenitors of the same descendant, sorted by Mvir descending'.>
pointer_logic.Descendant: <Describe which input field maps to the descendant. E.g. 'DescendantID column mapped to flat tree index via id_to_index dict'.>
pointer_logic.FirstHaloInFOFGroup: <Describe how the central halo is identified. E.g. 'HostHaloID == HaloID indicates central; otherwise map HostHaloID to tree index'.>
pointer_logic.NextHaloInFOFGroup: <Describe how the satellite chain is built. E.g. 'group halos by HostHaloID at the same snapshot, link in order of decreasing Mvir'.>

known_caveats: <Describe any known issues, edge cases, or deviations from ideal LHaloTree semantics. E.g. 'AHF MergerTree does not guarantee a unique main progenitor; ties broken by particle count'.>
